property_summary: For any actor who has deposited at least 1 ether and any withdrawal amount between 1 and their balance, a successful CashOut leaves c.balances(actor) equal to the pre-call balance minus exactly the withdrawn amount; the mutant never deducts, so the balance stays unchanged and violates this for every such input.
change_summary: Delete the statement that deducts _am from the caller's balance, so balances no longer decrease on CashOut.
